reference: phase2/improvement_sprint/L_low_lr epochs10-11; completed existing matched control, best retained epoch11
optimizer: Adam restored K moments/scaler/RNG; LR0.0001, betas0.9/0.999, eps1e-8, weight_decay0
objective: 0.5 unchanged BCE + 0.5 positive-pair Dice weighted by inverse training positive-pair frequency; mean over B*C; empty Dice terms zero; smoothing=1
crop_sampling: one sample per source image; choose its rarest present class by training image count, then a uniform native grid patch containing that class; negatives keep uniform grid sampling
selection: highest full-native val macro Dice at unchanged locked K thresholds; first tie wins
early_stopping: same L rule: patience2 without >=0.002 useful gain above K anchor; two-epoch cap matches L first2 epochs
safeguards: unchanged prior safeguards against K and matched L; no loosening after results; retain K if either fails

diagnostic_definitions.confusion: 16x16 GT label-set bitmask versus predicted label-set bitmask; four independent labels, never argmax
diagnostic_definitions.FP_partition: prediction of c with GT c absent: background if every GT absent, otherwise wrong-other-class; disjoint per channel
diagnostic_definitions.cross_pairs: GT row class i versus wrongly predicted column j, excluding pixels with GT j; multi-GT can contribute to multiple rows, so not additive/row-normalized
diagnostic_definitions.texture_proxy: 7x7 grayscale local standard deviation >=8 of255; association only, not proof of texture causation

test_use: no historical held-out evaluation or selection
auxiliary_formula: mean over B,H,W and six i<j pairs of sigmoid(z_i)*sigmoid(z_j)
rationale: Conservative bounded auxiliary [0,0.1] favors disjoint responses without imposing softmax. Single prespecified coefficient; no sweep.
zero_definition: Exactly zero if at most one channel has nonzero probability at each pixel. Finite unsaturated sigmoid outputs are strictly positive, so approximate exclusivity gives a small positive term, not mathematical zero.

safeguard_details.reference_checks: Same safeguards vs L without additional Dice-gain condition; require Dice >= matched L to recommend this auxiliary term.

L_provenance.note: K config copied for unchanged loss/crop settings retains historical J continuation_state_sha256; that inherited field describes K original origin, not this sprint initialization. Actual direct K state path/hash are explicit here and in preflight.json. Adam/scaler retained; only LR changed.
